newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia extends Helsinki gains in New York.
newsitem.headline: Nokia extends Helsinki gains in New York.

text.p: Shares in Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy on Monday extended earlier gains amid hopes for strong interim earnings and its A share ADR jumped $1-1/2 to $51-3/8 early in New York.
The price corresponds to about 232.60 markka.

In Helsinki at 1655/1455 GMT, Nokia stood at a new 232.00 markka calendar year-high and the highest since December 1 last year. It was up 7.50 markka or over three percent and trade was a lively 160 million markka.
The median of analysts' forecasts is for a nine-month profit of 2.2 billion markka, in a range of 2.01-2.43 billion.
The result is due on Thursday around noon Finnish time/1000 GMT.
